# Extra sections for visual / UI bugs ONLY

For bugs about layout, styling, rendering, or responsive behavior, append
these sections to the standard template:

```markdown
## Visual Details
- Viewport / resolution: <e.g. 390×844, 1920×1080>
- Zoom level: <100% unless stated>
- Theme: <light | dark>
- Affected component: <e.g. coupon input, cart summary card>

## Cross-browser Matrix
| Browser | Version | Reproduced? |
|---|---|---|
| Chrome | | |
| Safari | | |
| Firefox | | |

## Screenshots
- Before / after or expected / actual, annotated.
```

Naming: prefix the title area with `[UI]` in addition to the feature area,
e.g. `[UI][Coupon] …`.
